newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares up on rate hopes, others bourses.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares up on rate hopes, others bourses.

text.p: 1725 GMT - Shares closed firmer as other European bourses advanced and on mounting investor confidence of a further rate cut in Portugal in the near term.
*Volume was some 4.6 billion escudos in the cash market, with Portugal Telecom once again leading the way.
*Wednesday's slightly better than expected inflation figures for October and the strong performance of the bond market pointed to some rate action soon, traders said.
*Traders said they expected the positive tone to continue on Friday, although liquidity could be thinner.
*Sonae Investimentos gained just over one percent. The group is due to issue a report soon on its 1996 performance so far.
*Engil was also up just over one percent on optimism over its prospects although it failed to break above 1,700 escudos as some traders had predicted during the session.
*Traders said that pulp group Portucel Industrial appeared to be drawing support above 930 escudos.
